text: {"score":2,"justification":"Billing-side numbers match the card, but the documentation narrative contains an unsupported claim and several internal inconsistencies, and the next steps cite mismatched claims.","problems":["The summary says 'widespread duplicate note text' and 'most returned notes were flagged as duplicates'. The card shows no duplicate or paste metric; the 'problems 51%' figure is not identified as duplicates, and paste heavy is 0% and bulk created is 0%. This is an unsupported or contradictory claim that drives the main recommendation.","The headline asserts that duplicate text weakens support, which contradicts the listed note checks (paste heavy 0%, bulk created 0%).","The summary says 'show elevated in every complexity stratum', but the 5+ stratum has 0.286 vs 0.211 all-provider share (still higher), so this is okay; however z vs peers of 1.04 is not notable, and the summary does not interpret it, weakening the 'far above expectation' framing.","Next steps tell the reviewer to request 99215 charts 'starting with C0213629, C0214544', which are 99214 claims below the billed level, not 99215 claims. This is a mismatch.","The summary cites C0214752 as a low-complexity example in the narrative, but it is not in the cited claims list. It is also described as 'a 25-year-old with no chronic conditions and a Z09 follow-up', which matches the card, so this is only a citation-list gap.","'Leaning inconclusive' alongside 'billing side points toward upcoding' is somewhat muddled; the documentation sample of 17 is small, and the summary does not flag the 1,359 claims vs 45 documented claims gap clearly in the next steps."]}
